# Diary with lock

> Official website and landing pages for Diary with lock, a private diary, journal, and notes app for iPhone with password lock, personal styling, and cloud sync.

Diary with lock helps users record daily events, feelings, private thoughts, memories, and personal notes in a dedicated journaling space.

## Canonical pages

- [Homepage](https://diarywithlock.xyz/)
- [FAQ](https://diarywithlock.xyz/faq)
- [Private diary app for iPhone](https://diarywithlock.xyz/private-diary-app-iphone)
- [Diary app with password lock](https://diarywithlock.xyz/password-lock-diary)
- [Diary app with cloud sync](https://diarywithlock.xyz/cloud-sync-diary)

## Official app links

- [Diary with lock on the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/diary-with-lock/id1347511716)
- [Developer page on the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/tuyen-bui/id1000285801)

## Key facts

- Product type: private diary and journaling app for iPhone
- Main privacy feature: password lock
- Main retention feature: cloud sync across devices
- Main user benefit: a more personal and private writing experience than a plain notes app
- Official website: https://diarywithlock.xyz/
